title: Stochastic Calculus for Rough Fractional Brownian Motion via Operator Factorization
summary: We develop an operator-theoretic formulation of stochastic calculus for fractional Brownian motion with Hurst parameter H in (0, 1/2). The approach is based on adjointness between stochastic integration and differentiation in the Cameron-Martin space of the driving process. For Gaussian Volterra processes, we establish a canonical factorization of fluctuations (Id - E) = delta_X Pi_X D_X, where D_X := delta_X^* is the operator-covariant derivative (adjoint of the stochastic integral), delta_X the divergence, and Pi_X the predictable projection.
